pipeline_commit_note: d95e120e851d08dd0d66aea01de82d739895cd85 adds run.py/__init__.py; cabc3972c7ab48ef4b41e938987e3e013e30dbb5 adds the untracked dependency closure unchanged. Both precede this freeze commit.

policy.h2_model: HistGradientBoostingClassifier per target on the ordered 59-column F0 (reports/neural_refresh_20261022T0033Z/f0_schema.json)
policy.h2_row_weights: 0.5 ** (((S-s)/7d)/2), repeated over actual eligible rows and normalized to mean 1
policy.training_origins: daily 16:00Z origins s with s >= S-63d and s+7d <= A=S-3h, ascending; for on-grid S this equals report_train_origins(S) (56 origins); for off-grid S the same permitted-origin rule is applied relative to the given S
policy.training_label_as_of: A_S = S - 3h (LabelBuilder: event in [s, s+7d), seen_utc <= A_S)
policy.feature_cutoff: C = S - 4h; rows visible only if seen_utc < C
policy.p021_score: 0.5*rank01(p_H2) + 0.5*rank01(EW7), EW7 tau 7d, lookback 90d, source visibility time
policy.k_rule: k_t = P_persist7 positive count for target t on the scored population
policy.comparator: P_persist7: user has a visible row of that activity in [C-7d, C)
policy.context_only: H2/P016 (produced at no extra cost); REF/P021 not produced (needs extra fits)

population_rule: proxy: origin_population(source, S) = cohort users with >=5 visible rows (seen_utc) in [anchor-90d, anchor), anchor=S-14d-4h; file:<csv> and roster: the UserID column, validated as cohort users
label_as_of_rule: score labels for [S, S+7d) built as-of S+12d21h; refuse with NOT_MATURE if OfficialData.latest_observed() < S+12d21h

decision_rule.user_decision_2026_10_23: The user declined the lean-plan rule (which dropped the plan section 29.2 per-week -0.010 guard), then stated they will decide manually; Claude reports results only.
decision_rule.reported_quantities_fixed_in_advance: For each mature confirmation origin and pooled over all mature ones, on identical users and labels: combined, macro and micro F1 for H2/P021 and P_persist7, the H2/P021 minus P_persist7 delta, per-target F1, positive counts and k. H2/P016 as context only.

change_control: After this commit nothing in the policy, population or label rule may change. A pure bug fix must keep R1 exact and be logged as a dated deviation.
exposure_statement: No October outcome (no label window starting on or after 2026-10-01 used as an evaluation target) has been built or read before this freeze. run.py refuses October score runs while this file is absent. D3 (EXPERIMENT_LOG section 26.4) already accepted the overlap of the 10-07/10-14 confirm windows with the Oct 12 sanity holdout.
